name: Microgrid dead-system qualification
aliases: microgrids Microgrid black-start and restoration controls
summary: Checks the defined measurement and topology evidence used to identify the system-restoration starting condition.
description: Checks the defined measurement and topology evidence used to identify the system-restoration starting condition. Black-start and restoration control coordinates the establishment of an electrical reference and the gradual return of assigned resources and loads. A dead system, an available starting source and a successful load restoration are distinct states.

In a microgrid recovering from a blackout, an available grid-forming source can establish the assigned island reference before compatible generation and eligible load groups are introduced under the validated restoration strategy. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Voltage quality and topology” at the input and “Qualified dead-system state” at the output. Missing voltage data is not proof of a dead system.
